{{Top|leg}}
'''The Facility''' was the surface level of [[Vergesso Base]], and contained the station's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and related facilities. The surface of [[Vergesso Prime/Legends|Vergesso Prime]] was covered in individual [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] protected by [[magnetic field projector]]s, and could accommodate [[Starship/Legends|starships]] up to the size of [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] and [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]]. Two large areas served as docking cluster for [[capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], three [[turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] led to the [[The Life|other]] [[Base Operations Center|levels]] of the Base.

The Facility offered cargo processing, storage, and repair services. Rental of the hangars depended on the size of the starship berthed in them; smaller vessels were usually charged 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a day, larger vehicles 200 credits a day. Repairs both for ships and smaller [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles (in a dedicated garage) were 20% more expensive than that of legal port. Refuelling and restocking services were charged at 50 credits per crew member, multiplied by the number of [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of consumables required. Space in storage bays was rented by [[metric ton/Legends|ton]] (10 credits each) per [[standard month/Legends|month]]; some smugglers used the bays as a drop-off point, and the goods were collected later by their client. 

One of the farthest docking bays, [[Docking Bay 762]],<Ref>{{WEGCite|story=Slave Raid|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref> was discreetly used by the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]] (the actual owners of Vergesso) as transfer point for [[slavery/Legends|slaves]]; to maintain secrecy, the slaves were drugged and sealed in [[holding pod]]s, avoiding to risk an investigation by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and damaging their relations.
